ground_truth: Combines rows from two or more tables based on a related column, retaining matched rows (INNER) or preserving unmatched rows from one side (LEFT/RIGHT).
pre_quiz: What is the primary difference between an INNER JOIN and a LEFT JOIN?
pre_quiz_answer: INNER JOIN returns only rows with matches in both tables, whereas LEFT JOIN returns all rows from the left table with NULLs for missing matches.
post_quiz: If an employee has no assigned department, will they appear in an INNER JOIN or a LEFT JOIN with the departments table?
post_quiz_answer: They will appear in the LEFT JOIN (with NULL department values) but be omitted from the INNER JOIN.
